title: h5write
summary: Write dense numeric, logical, string, or char data to an HDF5 dataset.

gpu_support.notes: HDF5 serialization is host file I/O; GPU inputs are gathered before writing.

description: `h5write(filename, dataset, data)` creates or replaces a dense HDF5 dataset, creating intermediate groups as needed. `h5write(filename, dataset, data, start, count)` and `h5write(filename, dataset, data, start, count, stride)` write one-based hyperslab selections into an existing dataset.
behaviors: Numeric data is written as double, logical data as HDF5 booleans, and string/char data as UTF-8 variable-length strings.
RunMat column-major arrays are converted to HDF5 row-major raw order while preserving visible dimensions.
Partial writes use native HDF5 hyperslab writes and require the data shape to match the selected `count`.
Sparse, complex, cell, struct, object, and handle values raise deterministic unsupported-type errors.
